given: A SKU being viewed has no par level tracked
when: The team member views that SKU's detail
then: An explicit "not tracked" is shown for par level instead of a blank region or an error
architectural_notes: E2E: absent-optional-detail handling. Par level is a nullable domain field; the null-to-"not tracked" presentation default is owned in the stock-service DTO mapping (or the React detail component), never in the domain model, which stores a genuine null rather than a sentinel. Owner module: stock-service DTO projection plus the React detail page. Realizes the PO preference that a row missing optional detail renders cleanly with an explicit "not tracked", never a blank region or a null crash. Verified against a branch row seeded with a null par level.

independence.rationale: AC1/AC2/AC3 assert location, scope, and tracking-code content that exists; AC4 asserts the absent-optional-detail outcome. A build could render locations, scope, and tracking codes correctly (AC1-AC3 green) yet leave par level blank or crash on the null value (AC4 red).
